win.dictation.sounds: Sounds when listening starts and stops
开始和结束时的提示音
win.privacy.mic.detail: Used for narration, voice notes and dictation.
用于录屏讲解、语音备注和听写。
win.privacy.mic.off: Off in Windows Settings: Blurt can’t hear you.
已在 Windows 设置中关闭：口喷鸡听不到声音。
win.privacy.lead: Everything is stored on your PC, and speech is recognized here. Text goes to a cloud model only when you connect one in Models.
所有内容都存在本机，语音也在本机识别。只有在「模型」里连接云端模型后，文字才会发给它。
settings.screen_text.translate.hint: Translates text on the screen. Auto turns your language into the other one, and other languages into yours. With a specific language, text already in it is copied as is. Dictation’s Ctrl translation has its own setting.
将屏幕上的文字译成所选语言。「自动」将你的语言译成另一种语言，将其他语言译成你的语言。选择具体语言时，已是该语言的文字原样复制。听写的 Ctrl 翻译单独设置。
settings.general.live_text.hint: During a voice note or dictation, recognized text appears in a panel at the top of the screen. The panel never takes focus and stays clear of where you type.
语音备注或听写进行时，已识别的文字显示在屏幕顶部的面板中。面板不会抢占焦点，会避开输入位置。
settings.general.live_text.detail: Recognized text appears at the top of the screen.
已识别的文字显示在屏幕顶部。
win.general.notify.hint: Only while Blurt isn’t in front, and never with sound.
仅在口喷鸡不在前台时通知，且不发出声音。
win.about.updates.available: 口喷鸡 {1} 可以更新了
win.dictation.key.detail: Hold, tap or double-tap it on its own; Alt shortcuts still work.
单独按下时才触发，Alt 组合键照常使用。
win.dictation.restart: Takes effect the next time Blurt opens.
下次打开口喷鸡时生效。
win.models.failed: The download didn’t finish. Check the connection and try again.
下载没有完成。请检查网络后重试。
win.models.recognition.detail: Transcribes recordings and voice notes on this PC.
在本机转写录屏和语音备注。
win.cloud.region.note: The key is kept in Windows Credential Manager and only sent to that service.
Key 保存在 Windows 凭据管理器中，只发送给该服务。
win.cloud.ok: 已连接 · {1} 毫秒内响应
win.storage.show: 在文件资源管理器中显示
win.storage.dmabuf: Turn off WebKit DMA-BUF rendering (fixes a black window on NVIDIA)
关闭 WebKit DMA-BUF 渲染（修复 NVIDIA 显卡上的黑窗口）
win.storage.restart: 重新打开口喷鸡后生效。
win.keys.system: 与 Windows 快捷键冲突：{1}
win.keys.manual: On Wayland, add a shortcut in the system’s keyboard settings that runs “blurt {1}”
在 Wayland 上，请在系统键盘设置中添加运行「blurt {1}」的快捷键
win.keys.portal_note: On Wayland, shortcuts go through the desktop’s shortcut service; change them in the system’s keyboard settings.
在 Wayland 上，快捷键由桌面的快捷键服务管理，请在系统键盘设置中更改。
win.keys.invalid: Needs Ctrl, Alt or {1} (F-keys can stand alone)
需包含 Ctrl、Alt 或 {1}（F 键可单独使用）
win.projects.reveal: 在文件资源管理器中显示
dictation.settings.either_hint: Works only when pressed on its own; Alt shortcuts still work.
仅单独按下时触发，不影响 Alt 组合键。
settings.general.login_failed: Couldn’t change this. Change it in Windows Settings, under Apps > Startup.
无法更改，请在 Windows 设置的「应用 > 启动」中修改。
capture.keys.field_help: Click, then press the new keys. Esc cancels, Backspace removes the shortcut.
点按后按下新的组合键。Esc 取消，Backspace 删除这个快捷键。
models.job.none: Not set. Add a cloud model.
未设置。请添加云端模型。
dictation.settings.cancel_key.detail: In terminals like Claude Code, Esc stops the running task. With Ctrl+Esc or Shift+Esc, Esc alone never cancels dictation.
在 Claude Code 等终端中，Esc 会中断正在运行的任务。改为 Ctrl+Esc 或 Shift+Esc 后，单独按 Esc 不会取消听写。
settings.general.collect.hint: Screenshots Windows saves to Pictures\Screenshots (Win+Print Screen, the Snipping Tool) are also added as cards.
Windows 存到「图片\屏幕截图」的截图（Win+Print Screen、截图工具）也会添加为卡片。
settings.general.card_drag.hint: Picture, then the note: the picture is dropped and the note is copied, so Ctrl+V pastes it after the picture. Picture with the note under it: the dragged picture is a copy with the note in a strip under it, for apps that take one picture and nothing else; the snap itself stays clean. With either, a note that couldn't go in is put on the clipboard for Ctrl+V. Picture only: just the picture.
先放图片，再贴备注：放下图片，同时复制备注，按 Ctrl+V 贴在图片后面。图片下方印上备注：拖出的是在下方加了备注条的副本，适用于只接收一张图片的 App，原截图不变。以上两种方式中，备注没贴上时会放入剪贴板，按 Ctrl+V 粘贴。只放图片：仅拖出图片。
win.storage.logs.detail: What Blurt wrote while it ran
口喷鸡运行时写下的记录
win.storage.free_note: Moved to the Recycle Bin: restore it from there.
已移到回收站，可从回收站还原。
capture.action.cards.detail: Brings down the cards hanging under the island
win.capture.action.pen.help: While it’s on, drag to draw on the recording; hold Shift for a box, Alt for an oval. Esc puts the pen down.
打开后拖动即可在录屏上画；按住 Shift 画方框，按住 Alt 画椭圆。按 Esc 放下画笔。
dictation.voiceprint.passage: I’m setting up dictation on my PC. Tomorrow morning I’ll go through the project plan with the team, answer a few emails, and send the meeting notes before Friday. If anything changes, I’ll update the document and let everyone know.
我正在设置电脑上的语音输入。明天上午我会和团队过一遍项目计划，回复几封邮件，周五之前把会议纪要发出来。如果计划有变化，我会更新文档，再通知大家。
settings.general.assistant.detail: Shortcuts, dictation, the speech model and a first try, in four steps.
快捷键、听写、语音模型和试用，共四步。
